lock_held_takeover.note: The lease-row lock case is measured separately from this network-disconnect/reconnect arm.

observation_synchronization: runtime-a used a zero-default diagnostic 3000ms hold after lease acquisition so its PostgreSQL network could be disconnected from an observed owner; the hold is excluded from takeover and recovery timing.
limitations: Local containers are not independent hosts.
This scenario does not measure database-host failure or production availability.
The diagnostic observation hold is not a recovery-time measurement.
The network arm is a container-network fault, not an independent-host or database-host failure.
